mechanics.claim: The shadow wave (damage) is a narrow beam at the center, separate from the broad light wave (shield); enemy champions hit by the shadow wave take damage while allies hit by the light wave get shielded.
mechanics.quote: The beam consists of a broad wave of light, and a narrow wave of shadow at the center.

mechanics.claim: The projectile can be destroyed by a spell shield or similar, which also destroys the damage-dealing shadow wave.
mechanics.quote:
The broad wave is a singular projectile that can be {{tip|projectile|destroyed}}.
** The narrow wave will be destroyed with it in the process.

mechanics.claim: Senna is revealed during the cast time.
mechanics.quote: '''Senna''' reveals herself during the cast time.
